summary: Current official TKGM Parsel Sorgu configuration was followed to its public MEGSİS API. Three anonymous coordinate requests returned two distinct local parcel polygons; a two-feature safe-ID sample is retained, but citywide coverage and formal CRS remain unverified.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Turkish discovery queries are recorded in city-1395-erkezk-y.json. First-party results established TKGM/MEGSİS and the Çerkezköy district Tapu Müdürlüğü; no third-party source was used as registry custody evidence.
